title: F06 · seen · Seen at 9:41
lines: He has read his own message forty times,
He started typing. Sorry if that was too much.
He started typing. "Sorry if that was too much."
On the shelf, the diya his grandmother lit was still burning.
He looked at it for a while.
What is real does not need to be chased. What is not, will not come by begging.
Say it once. Then let it be. That is sadhana.
